collocations.phrase: the word “kung fu”, which refers to Chinese martial arts
collocations.translation: “kung fu”一词，指中国武术（课文原句）
collocations.example: An example of this is the word “kung fu”, which refers to Chinese martial arts. 一个例子是“kung fu”这个词，它指中国武术。
He practises kung fu every morning in the park. 他每天早上在公园练功夫。
Kung fu is among the best-known Chinese martial arts. 功夫是最著名的中国武术之一。
Bruce Lee starred in many famous kung fu movies. 李小龙主演了许多著名功夫片。
Kung fu training begins with balance and footwork.
The coach demonstrated three basic kung fu techniques.
Visitors can learn kung fu at the cultural centre.
The documentary follows students at a kung fu school.

synonyms.example: She has practised martial arts for years. 她练武术多年。
synonyms.usage: martial arts 是各类武术的统称（常用复数）；kung fu 特指中国功夫。课文正是用 which refers to Chinese martial arts 来解释 kung fu。

synonyms.translation: 武术（现代竞赛或表演体系）
synonyms.example: She competes in international wushu events.
synonyms.usage: wushu 是相关术语而非所有语境下的完全同义词，多指中国武术的现代竞赛体系；kung fu 在英语中泛指中国传统功夫。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·非限制性定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: An example of this is the word “kung fu”, which refers to Chinese martial arts.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明先行词；非限制性定语从句只能用 which，不能用 that（本单元语法：定语从句综述）。

advancedExpressions.expression: kung fu / tofu / tai chi / typhoon / lychee
advancedExpressions.example: 汉语进入英语的音译词；反向如 golf→高尔夫、tank→坦克，印证课文"语言互借"主题。

advancedExpressions.expression: practise kung fu / a kung fu master / martial arts / self-defence
advancedExpressions.example: He learned kung fu for self-defence. 他学功夫用于防身。

sentenceUpgrade.original: He has practised kung fu since childhood.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He has practised kung fu since childhood, training with the same instructor for twelve years.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

sentenceUpgrade.original: The festival included a kung fu demonstration.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The festival included a kung fu demonstration, drawing a large crowd to the central square.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

classPractice.question: An example of this is the word “kung fu”, ____ refers to Chinese martial arts. (填适当的关系词)
classPractice.note: 课文原句。逗号后为非限制性定语从句，只能用 which，不能用 that（本单元语法：定语从句综述）。

classPractice.question: 他从十岁起就一直练功夫。
classPractice.answer: He has practised kung fu since he was ten.
classPractice.note: practise kung fu 练功夫；since 从句配现在完成时。

classPractice.question: 功夫是最著名的中国武术之一。Kung fu is one of the best-known Chinese ____ ____.
classPractice.note: martial arts 武术（统称，常用复数）。

translation: vt. 反对，抵制；与…对垒
original_sentence: Borrowed words are an outcome of language development that can hardly be avoided, but some language communities oppose adopting words from other cultures.
definitionEn: to disagree with, resist, or compete against someone or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反对，抵制（计划、政策、做法等；后接名词或动名词，不接不定式）
uncommonMeanings.example: They strongly opposed the new tax. 他们强烈反对新税。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）与……对垒，与……竞争（比赛、竞选中作对手）
uncommonMeanings.example: Who is opposing you in the match?（课件）比赛中谁和你对垒？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （观点等）截然相反的，对立的
uncommonMeanings.example: The two sides hold completely opposed views. 双方观点完全对立。

posExamples.sentence: Several residents opposed the road expansion.
The senator opposed cutting the education budget.
Our team will oppose the champions tomorrow.

wordForms.verb: oppose 反对；与……对垒
wordForms.noun: opposition 反对（opposition to sth）；the Opposition 反对党；opponent 对手，反对者（指人）
wordForms.adjective: opposing 对立的，对垒的（opposing armies/teams/views）；opposed 反对的（be opposed to）；opposite 对面的，相反的
wordForms.other: 辨析：opponent 指"人"（对手），opposition 指抽象的"反对（行为/势力）"；opposite 表方位或性质"相反"，opposing 表"相互对抗的双方"。重音：oppose /əˈpəʊz/ 在第二音节，opposite /ˈɒpəzɪt/ 在第一音节。

collocations.phrase: oppose adopting words from other cultures
collocations.translation: 反对吸收来自其他文化的词（课文原句；oppose + doing）
collocations.example: Borrowed words are an outcome of language development that can hardly be avoided, but some language communities oppose adopting words from other cultures. 外来词是语言发展中难以避免的产物，但一些语言社群反对吸收来自其他文化的词汇。
Many parents oppose bilingual education. 许多家长反对双语教育。

collocations.translation: 【课件】反对（做）某事（to 为介词）
collocations.example: I am opposed to bilingual education. 我反对双语教育。
This exercise develops flexibility as opposed to strength. 这项运动锻炼柔韧性而非力量。
Who is opposing you in the match? 比赛中谁和你对垒？
Much of the opposition to this plan has come from the media. 对该计划的反对多来自媒体。

collocations.translation: 【课件】对垒的军队；对立的观点
collocations.example: The opposing armies were preparing for war. 对垒的两军正在备战。
Local businesses strongly opposed the parking ban.

synonyms.example: She objected to being treated like a child. 她反对被当作小孩对待。
synonyms.usage: object 是不及物动词，必须接 to（介词）再接名词/动名词；oppose 是及物动词，直接接宾语：oppose (doing) sth。

synonyms.example: Most people are against the plan. 大多数人反对这个计划。
synonyms.usage: be against 为"be+介词短语"作表语，最口语化；oppose 语体更正式，多用于书面。

synonyms.example: They resisted the changes to the rules. 他们抵制规则的改动。
synonyms.usage: resist 强调用行动抵抗、抗拒（resist doing sth）；oppose 强调表态反对。

advancedExpressions.expression: oppose (doing) sth = be opposed to (doing) sth = object to (doing) sth = be against (doing) sth
advancedExpressions.example: 四种说法中 to 均为介词（oppose 直接及物），后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

advancedExpressions.expression: opposition to / in opposition to / meet with strong opposition / the Opposition
advancedExpressions.example: The proposal met with strong opposition. 提案遭到强烈反对。

advancedExpressions.expression: Borrowed words are an outcome of language development that can hardly be avoided, but some language communities oppose adopting words from other cultures.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：oppose 后接动名词 adopting 作宾语，不可接不定式；前半句 that can hardly be avoided 为定语从句修饰 outcome（本单元语法：定语从句综述）。

advancedExpressions.expression: be opposed to 反对 / opposing armies 对垒的两军 / the opposite direction 相反的方向
advancedExpressions.example: They walked in opposite directions while the opposing teams warmed up. 对垒双方热身时，他们朝相反方向走去。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Several residents opposed the road expansion.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Several residents opposed the road expansion, fearing it would destroy the community garden.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

sentenceUpgrade.original: The senator opposed cutting the education budget.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The senator opposed cutting the education budget, arguing that rural schools already lacked resources.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

classPractice.question: 反对双语教育：I ____ ____ ____ bilingual education.
classPractice.note: 原题型：完成句子（课件）。be opposed to (doing) sth，to 为介词；也可直接说 oppose bilingual education。

classPractice.question: This exercise develops flexibility ____ ____ ____ (相对于) strength.
classPractice.note: 原题型：完成句子（课件）。as opposed to 而不是；与……相对，用于对比。

classPractice.question: The ____ (oppose) armies were preparing for war.
classPractice.note: 原题型：单句语法填空（课件）。opposing 作定语，"对垒的、敌对的"两军。

classPractice.question: Much of the ____ ____ (oppose) this plan has come from the media.
classPractice.note: 原题型：单句语法填空（课件）。名词 opposition 后固定接介词 to。

classPractice.question: 和你对垒：Who is ____ ____ in the match?
classPractice.note: 原题型：完成句子（课件）。熟词僻义：oppose sb（比赛中）与某人对垒，及物动词。

classPractice.question: Borrowed words are an outcome of language development that can hardly be avoided, but some language communities oppose ____ (adopt) words from other cultures.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：oppose + doing sth，接动名词作宾语。

translation: n. 干涉行为，干预
definitionEn: action taken to change, improve, or prevent a difficult situation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 干涉，干预（行为）
uncommonMeanings.example: They opposed any foreign intervention in their internal affairs. 他们反对外国对其内政的任何干涉。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】插话，打断（= interrupt）
uncommonMeanings.example: "…," she intervened. "……"她插话道。（课件）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（熟词僻义）（事情）发生以致干扰，从中作梗
uncommonMeanings.example: They were planning to get married and then the war intervened. 他们正打算结婚，战争却从中作梗。（课件）

posExamples.sentence: Early intervention improved the child's reading.
The crisis ended without military intervention.
The doctor recommended a minor surgical intervention.

wordForms.noun: intervention 干预，干涉
wordForms.verb: intervene（vi.）干预（intervene in）；插话；（事情）干扰
wordForms.other: 构词：inter-（在……之间）+ ven（来，拉丁词根 venire）→"来到中间"即干预、介入；词根 ven 家族：prevent（提前来到→阻止）、event（发生的事）、convention（共同前来→大会）；前缀 inter- 家族：international、interact、interrupt、interpret。重音在第三音节 /ˌɪntəˈvenʃn/。

collocations.phrase: make interventions in sth / to do sth
collocations.example: The government made interventions in the market. 政府对市场进行了干预。
They call for government intervention to regulate prices. 他们呼吁政府干预以调控物价。

collocations.translation: 【课件】干预，介入（intervene 为不及物动词）
collocations.example: The US doesn't want to intervene in disputes between Ukraine and Russia. 美国不想介入乌俄之间的争端。
Early intervention can stop the disease from worsening. 早期干预能阻止病情恶化。
The two sides settled the dispute without outside intervention. 双方在无外部干预下解决了争端。
Timely intervention prevented the dispute from escalating.
The debate focused on the limits of humanitarian intervention.
Teachers selected an intervention strategy for struggling readers.

synonyms.example: They resent any interference in their affairs. 他们讨厌任何对其事务的干涉。
synonyms.usage: interference 贬义较强（多管闲事式的干涉，动词 interfere in/with）；intervention 中性，常指官方、有目的地出面干预（动词 intervene in）。

synonyms.example: He finished his speech without interruption. 他的演讲没有被打断。
synonyms.usage: 对应 intervene 的"插话"义：interrupt 是及物动词（interrupt sb），intervene 是不及物动词；interruption 指打断行为本身。

advancedExpressions.expression: intervene in a dispute / government intervention / call for intervention / without outside intervention
advancedExpressions.example: The UN intervened in the dispute. 联合国介入了这场争端。

advancedExpressions.expression: intervene（来到中间→干预）/ prevent（提前来→阻止）/ event / convention
advancedExpressions.example: inter + ven + e："来到两者之间"，故 intervene 表干预、介入、插话。

advancedExpressions.expression: intervene in = step in = get involved in
advancedExpressions.example: The teacher stepped in / intervened to stop the quarrel. 老师出面制止了争吵。（step in 较口语，intervene 正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: "…," she intervened. 她插话道
advancedExpressions.example: intervene 指在对话中插进来说话（不及物）；interrupt 强调打断别人（及物：interrupt sb）。

sentenceUpgrade.original: Early intervention improved the child's reading.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Early intervention improved the child's reading, addressing sound recognition before frustration developed.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

sentenceUpgrade.original: The crisis ended without military intervention.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The crisis ended without military intervention, after both sides accepted an independent mediator.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

classPractice.question: The US doesn't want to ____ ____ disputes between Ukraine and Russia.
classPractice.note: 原题型：完成句子（课件）。intervene 为不及物动词，"干预、介入"须接介词 in。

classPractice.question: 呼吁政府干预以调控物价
classPractice.answer: call for government intervention to regulate prices
classPractice.note: 原题型：汉译英（课件）。call for 呼吁；government intervention 政府干预；不定式表目的。

classPractice.question: They were planning to get married and then the war ____ (intervene).
classPractice.note: 原题型：单句语法填空（课件）。熟词僻义：（事情）发生以致干扰、从中作梗；与 was planning 对应用一般过去时。

classPractice.question: They called for government ____ (intervene) in the housing market.
classPractice.note: government 为名词作定语，空格处作 for 的宾语中心词，需名词形式 intervention。

translation: adj. 纯净的；完全的
original_sentence: There are countries that make interventions to keep their native language pure in order to defend their identity.
definitionEn: (1) not mixed or contaminated (2) complete, absolute, or morally innocent

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纯净的，不掺杂质的（本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The mountain air is wonderfully pure. 山间的空气无比纯净。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 完全的，纯粹的（表强调，只作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was pure luck that he passed the exam. 他通过考试纯属运气。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纯理论的（与 applied 应用的 相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: He studies pure mathematics rather than applied mathematics. 他研究纯数学而非应用数学。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纯洁的，清白的
uncommonMeanings.example: She was pure in heart and deed. 她心地和行为都很纯洁。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （声音、颜色）清亮的，纯正的
uncommonMeanings.example: She sang in a high, pure voice. 她的歌声高亢清亮。

posExamples.sentence: The laboratory requires pure water.
Their meeting was pure coincidence.
The sample contained ninety-nine percent pure silver.

wordForms.adjective: pure 纯净的（比较级 purer，最高级 purest）
wordForms.noun: purity 纯净，纯正（课件词族：pure–purity）；purist 纯粹主义者
wordForms.verb: purify 净化，提纯
wordForms.adverb: purely 纯粹地，完全地（purely by chance 纯属偶然）
wordForms.other: 构词法：pure + -ify → purify（-ify 使……化，如 simplify/beautify）；pure + -ity → purity（形→名，如 secure–security）

collocations.translation: 课文原句：保持母语纯正
collocations.example: Some countries make interventions to keep their native language pure. 有些国家采取干预措施保持母语纯正。

collocations.translation: 使……保持纯净（形容词作补语/表语）
collocations.example: They try to keep the tradition pure. 他们努力保持传统的纯正。
We need pure water to survive. 我们需要纯净的水才能生存。
The ring is made of pure gold. 这枚戒指是纯金做的。

collocations.translation: 纯属巧合/运气（pure 表'完全的'）
collocations.example: It was pure coincidence that we met. 我们相遇纯属巧合。
We met at the station purely by chance.
The claim is pure and simple nonsense.
Her expression showed pure joy.

synonyms.example: Wash it in clean water. 用干净的水洗它。
synonyms.usage: clean 指无污垢脏物；pure 指不掺杂质（pure water 无杂质的纯水）。二者都可作定语和表语。

synonyms.example: It was sheer luck that we escaped. 我们逃脱纯属运气。
synonyms.usage: 表'完全的、纯粹的'时 pure 与 sheer 同义，且这一义项都只能作定语：pure/sheer luck，不能说 The luck was pure。

advancedExpressions.expression: pure → purity(n.) / purify(v.) / purely(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: They fight to preserve the purity of their language. 他们努力保持语言的纯正。

advancedExpressions.expression: There are countries that make interventions...（关系代词 that 指物、在从句中作主语，引导限制性定语从句，不可省略）
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句先行词为 countries，that 作从句主语；There be + 名词 + that 从句是写作常用句型。

advancedExpressions.expression: pure / sheer / mere + 名词 = 纯粹是……
advancedExpressions.example: By pure chance he found the key. 他纯属偶然找到了钥匙。

sentenceUpgrade.original: The laboratory requires pure water.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The laboratory requires pure water, preventing minerals from affecting the experiment.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

sentenceUpgrade.original: Their meeting was pure coincidence.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Their meeting was pure coincidence, since neither knew the other would attend.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

classPractice.question: They made interventions to keep their native language ____ (purity).
classPractice.note: keep + 宾语 + 形容词作宾语补足语；由名词 purity 还原为形容词 pure。呼应课文原句。

classPractice.question: 我们相遇纯属巧合。 It was ____ ____ that we met.
classPractice.note: pure 表'完全的、纯粹的'，此义项只作定语。

classPractice.question: This equipment is used to ____ (pure) the drinking water in rural areas.
classPractice.note: 不定式 to 后接动词原形；pure→purify（净化），课件词族拓展。

translation: n. 部落
original_sentence: Some languages have an extremely small number of speakers, such as the Native American Navajo language, used only by the members of the tribe.
definitionEn: a social group united by ancestry, culture, leadership, or shared identity

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 部落（本义：有共同语言、文化和首领的群体）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two tribes lived peacefully side by side. 两个部落和睦相邻。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （动植物的）族，类
uncommonMeanings.example: Lions belong to the cat tribe. 狮子属于猫族。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式，常幽默）一大帮人，一伙人
uncommonMeanings.example: A tribe of noisy children rushed in. 一大帮吵闹的孩子冲了进来。

posExamples.sentence: The tribe preserves its language through storytelling.
Several tribes share access to the river.
An elected council represents the tribe.

wordForms.noun: tribe 部落；tribesman 部落成员
wordForms.adjective: tribal 部落的（tribal leaders 部落首领）
wordForms.other: 发音贴士：tribe /traɪb/ 与 bribe 押韵；形容词 tribal /ˈtraɪbl/ 重音在前

collocations.example: The Navajo language is used only by the members of the tribe. 纳瓦霍语只有该部落成员使用。
Native tribes have lived here for centuries. 土著部落已在此居住数百年。
He belongs to a nomadic tribe. 他属于一个游牧部落。
The school offers lessons in the tribal language.
The exhibition documents several tribal customs.
A tribal leader opened the community meeting.
The law protects water sources on tribal land.
The researchers worked with an indigenous tribe in the region.

synonyms.example: The whole clan gathered for the festival. 全族人聚在一起过节。
synonyms.usage: clan 强调血缘宗族（尤指苏格兰氏族）；tribe 指有共同语言、文化、首领的部落群体，人类学常用词。二者都是可数名词。

synonyms.example: Several ethnic groups live in the region.
synonyms.usage: ethnic group 是中性社会学术语，搭配 minority/indigenous ethnic group；tribe 强调共同祖先、社会组织或传统领导，不应随意用于所有族群。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·分词作定语（定语从句的简化）
advancedExpressions.expression: the Navajo language, used only by the members of the tribe = the Navajo language, which is used only by...
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句用过去分词短语作后置定语，相当于非限制性定语从句；写作可仿写：a language spoken only by a small tribe。

advancedExpressions.expression: tribe 部落 / ethnic group 族群 / minority 少数民族 / community 社群
advancedExpressions.example: The Navajo are a Native American tribe. 纳瓦霍人是一个美洲原住民部落。

advancedExpressions.expression: the members of the tribe / a native/local tribe / belong to a tribe / tribal language / tribal customs / tribal leader / tribal land / indigenous tribe
advancedExpressions.example: The school offers lessons in the tribal language.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The tribe preserves its language through storytelling.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The tribe preserves its language through storytelling, teaching traditional songs to younger generations.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

sentenceUpgrade.original: Several tribes share access to the river.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Several tribes share access to the river, meeting each season to agree on fishing limits.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

classPractice.question: The ____ (tribe) chief made the final decision for the whole village.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 chief 用形容词 tribal 作定语。

classPractice.question: 这种语言只被部落成员使用。 The language is used only by ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；注意两处定冠词 the。

classPractice.question: The Navajo language, which is used only by the tribe, is disappearing. → The Navajo language, ____ only by the tribe, is disappearing.
classPractice.note: 定语从句(which is used)可简化为过去分词短语 used（被动关系），对应课文原句写法。

translation: vt. 拒绝接受，不予考虑；不录用；排斥，排异
original_sentence: Under this circumstance, it becomes a matter of survival for the native language to reject outside influences.
definitionEn: to refuse to accept, approve, believe, or keep someone or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拒绝接受，否决（建议、提议、观点）
uncommonMeanings.example: The committee rejected the plan. 委员会否决了这项计划。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不录用，不录取
uncommonMeanings.example: She was rejected by two law schools. 两所法学院都没录取她。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （身体）排斥（移植的器官）
uncommonMeanings.example: His body rejected the new heart. 他的身体对新移植的心脏产生了排异。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冷落，不理睬（使人感到不被关爱）
uncommonMeanings.example: She felt rejected by her parents. 她感到被父母冷落。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】次品，被淘汰者（读作 /ˈriːdʒekt/，重音在前）
uncommonMeanings.example: Store rejects are sold at half price. 商店次品半价出售。

posExamples.sentence: The committee rejected the incomplete application.
Scientists rejected the original explanation.
The body may reject a transplanted organ.

wordForms.verb: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ 拒绝；排斥
wordForms.noun: rejection 拒绝；排斥，排异（课件：meet with/encounter rejection 遭到拒绝）；reject /ˈriːdʒekt/ 次品
wordForms.other: 重音贴士：动词 reJECT 重音在后，名词 REject（次品）重音在前，类似 record / present / object；构词法：re-(回) + -ject(扔) = 扔回去→拒绝

collocations.translation: 课文原句：排斥外来影响
collocations.example: It becomes a matter of survival for the native language to reject outside influences. 排斥外来影响成了母语的生存问题。
The proposal was firmly rejected. 这项提议被断然拒绝。
I have been rejected by all the universities I applied to. 所有我申请的大学都没录取我。
When her husband left home she felt rejected and useless. 丈夫离家后她感到被抛弃、一无是处。
Be brave even if you meet with rejection. 即使遭到拒绝也要勇敢。
He received a rejection letter from the company. 他收到了公司的拒信。

collocations.phrase: the rejection of a transplanted organ
collocations.example: Drugs reduce the risk of rejection of a newly transplanted organ. 药物可降低新移植器官的排异风险。
The court rejected the claim for lack of evidence.

synonyms.example: She refused to answer the question. 她拒绝回答这个问题。
synonyms.usage: refuse 可接 to do（refuse to do sth），reject 不能接 to do，只接名词宾语（reject an offer/a proposal）；reject 语气更断然、更正式。

synonyms.example: He turned down the job offer. 他拒绝了这份工作。
synonyms.usage: turn down 是口语化短语动词，宾语为代词时必须放中间（turn it down）；reject 更正式书面。

synonyms.example: He politely declined the invitation. 他礼貌地婉拒了邀请。
synonyms.usage: decline 指委婉、礼貌地拒绝（邀请等），可接 to do；reject 直接、生硬。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·定语从句（课件例句）
advancedExpressions.expression: I have been rejected by all the universities (that/which) I applied to.（关系代词作介词 to 的宾语，可省略）
advancedExpressions.example: 也可写成 all the universities to which I applied：介词提到关系代词前时只能用 which，且不可省略。本单元语法：定语从句综述。

advancedExpressions.expression: reject / refuse / turn down / decline / deny
advancedExpressions.example: reject an offer（断然拒绝）；decline an invitation（婉拒）；deny 是'否认'，deny sb sth 才表'拒绝给予'。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ject 词根（=throw 扔）

advancedExpressions.example: 记住词根 -ject（扔），一串词一起记。

translation: adj. 悲观的，悲观主义的
original_sentence: While some communities are pessimistic about the exchange between languages, there are also other communities that readily welcome borrowed words.
definitionEn: expecting bad results or believing that a situation is unlikely to improve

posExamples.sentence: Analysts remain pessimistic about short-term growth.
She felt pessimistic after the second rejection.
The forecast presents an unnecessarily pessimistic picture.

wordForms.adjective: pessimistic 悲观的 ↔ optimistic 乐观的
wordForms.noun: pessimism 悲观情绪，悲观主义 ↔ optimism 乐观主义；pessimist 悲观主义者 ↔ optimist 乐观主义者
wordForms.other: 构词法：pessim-(最坏) + -ist(人) + -ic(形容词后缀)；与 optimistic（optim- = 最好）成对记忆；重音落在 -mis-：/ˌpesɪˈmɪstɪk/

collocations.example: Some communities are pessimistic about the exchange between languages. 一些社群对语言间的交流持悲观态度。
He takes a pessimistic view of the future. 他对未来持悲观看法。
Experts remain pessimistic about the economy. 专家们对经济仍然悲观。
Investors became deeply pessimistic after the warning.
Residents are increasingly pessimistic about the stalled repairs.
Even the pessimistic forecast expects some growth.
I do not want to sound pessimistic, but the deadline is unrealistic.
The early estimates proved overly pessimistic.

synonyms.example: Don't be so negative about your chances. 别对你的机会那么消极。
synonyms.usage: negative 泛指消极、否定；pessimistic 特指'预期会有坏结果'，常接 about sth；二者都可作定语和表语。

synonyms.example: The report paints a gloomy picture of the industry. 报告描绘了该行业的黯淡前景。
synonyms.usage: gloomy 既可修饰人也可修饰事物本身（a gloomy forecast 黯淡的预测）；pessimistic 一般修饰人或人的看法态度。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·乐观与悲观
advancedExpressions.expression: be pessimistic/optimistic about... = take a pessimistic/positive view of...
advancedExpressions.example: I'm optimistic about the result. 我对结果很乐观。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·while 对比 + 定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: While some communities are pessimistic..., there are also other communities that readily welcome borrowed words.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：while 表对比'然而'；that 引导限制性定语从句，在从句中作主语，修饰 communities。本单元语法：定语从句综述。

advancedExpressions.expression: pessimist/optimist（人）→ pessimism/optimism（主义）→ pessimistic/optimistic（形容词）
advancedExpressions.example: 一族六词成对记，高考语法填空高频考点。

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Analysts remain pessimistic about short-term growth, citing weak demand and rising borrowing costs.

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She felt pessimistic after the second rejection, although two other applications were still under review.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语补充同一场景的细节或结果

classPractice.note: 形容词 pessimistic 与名词 optimist（乐观主义者）对比；while 表对比。

classPractice.note: 介词 for 后接名词；'悲观情绪'用 pessimism。

translation: adj. 日耳曼语的；德国的
original_sentence: English, especially, is based on a mix of Latin, Greek and Germanic languages.
definitionEn: relating to the peoples or languages of the Germanic branch of the Indo-European family

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 日耳曼语族的（语言学概念：英语、德语、荷兰语等同属日耳曼语族）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有德国人特征的，日耳曼式的
uncommonMeanings.example: He admired their Germanic sense of order. 他钦佩他们日耳曼式的秩序感。

posExamples.sentence: English belongs to the Germanic language family.

wordForms.adjective: Germanic 日耳曼(语族)的；German 德国的，德语的
wordForms.noun: Germany 德国；German 德国人，德语
wordForms.other: 专有形容词首字母必须大写；辨析：German 指现代德国/德语，Germanic 指整个日耳曼语族（历史与语言学概念）

collocations.translation: 课文原句：日耳曼语族语言
collocations.example: English is based on a mix of Latin, Greek and Germanic languages. 英语以拉丁语、希腊语和日耳曼语的混合为基础。

collocations.phrase: be based on a mix of...
collocations.translation: 课文原句：以……的混合为基础
collocations.example: The dish is based on a mix of local ingredients. 这道菜以当地多种食材的混合为基础。
English is part of the Germanic language family.

The dictionary identifies the word's Germanic roots.
Scholars reconstruct forms from Proto-Germanic.

synonyms.example: She speaks fluent German. 她德语说得很流利。
synonyms.usage: German 指现代国家德国及其语言；Germanic 用于语言学/历史语境，指日耳曼语族（含英语、德语、荷兰语等）或'日耳曼式的'。二者作定语或表语，首字母均大写。

synonyms.example: Germanic languages form one branch of the Indo-European family.

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·语言学词汇（本单元话题）
advancedExpressions.expression: Latin 拉丁语 / Greek 希腊语 / Germanic 日耳曼语的 / borrowed words 外来词 / native language 母语
advancedExpressions.example: Many English words are borrowed from Latin and Greek. 许多英语单词借自拉丁语和希腊语。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ic 形容词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: German→Germanic；类似 hero→heroic, base→basic, history→historic
advancedExpressions.example: -ic 加在名词后构成形容词，重音常落在 -ic 前一个音节：Ger-MAN-ic /dʒɜːˈmænɪk/。

advancedExpressions.expression: Germanic languages / be based on a mix of... / the Germanic language family / West Germanic / North Germanic / Germanic origin / Germanic roots / Proto-Germanic

translation: n. 语言学家；通晓数国语言的人
original_sentence: According to the linguist Edward Sapir, “It would be difficult to point to a completely isolated language ...” For better or for worse, the tendency to borrow words has never gone out of style.
definitionEn: a specialist in language or a person skilled in learning and using languages

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 语言学家（研究语言的学者）
uncommonMeanings.example: Linguists study how languages change over time. 语言学家研究语言如何随时间演变。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 通晓数国语言的人，有语言天赋的人
uncommonMeanings.example: I'm afraid I'm no linguist. 恐怕我没有语言天赋。

posExamples.sentence: The linguist recorded the endangered language.
A forensic linguist examined the anonymous letter.
She is a talented linguist who speaks six languages.

wordForms.noun: linguist 语言学家；linguistics 语言学（学科名，谓语用单数）
wordForms.adjective: linguistic 语言(学)的（linguistic skills 语言技能）
wordForms.other: 构词法：lingu-(舌头/语言) + -ist(人)；同根词 bilingual 双语的、language 语言；linguistics 形似复数实为单数：Linguistics is a science.

collocations.phrase: according to the linguist Edward Sapir
collocations.translation: 课文原句：根据语言学家爱德华·萨丕尔的说法
collocations.example: According to the linguist Edward Sapir, no language is completely isolated. 根据语言学家萨丕尔的说法，没有语言是完全孤立的。
She's a gifted linguist, fluent in five languages. 她很有语言天赋，五种语言都流利。
A professional linguist reviewed the translation.
The company hired a computational linguist to improve speech recognition.
A historical linguist traced the change across centuries.
The field linguist recorded speakers in remote villages.
As a skilled linguist, she learned the local language quickly.
His linguistic research focuses on bilingual children.

synonyms.example: As a polyglot, she interprets at conferences. 作为通晓多语的人，她在会议上做口译。
synonyms.usage: polyglot 是高阶词，专指'会说多门语言的人'；linguist 既可指语言学家，也可口语化地指语言学得好的人。

synonyms.example: A language scientist analysed the speech recordings.

translation: n. 趋势，趋向；倾向，偏好
original_sentence: According to the linguist Edward Sapir, “It would be difficult to point to a completely isolated language ...” For better or for worse, the tendency to borrow words has never gone out of style.
definitionEn: a usual direction, pattern, habit, or likelihood to behave in a particular way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 趋势，趋向（社会、统计上的客观走向），常用 a tendency for sb/sth to do
uncommonMeanings.example: There is a growing tendency for people to work from home. 居家办公的趋势日益增长。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （性格中的）倾向，癖好，常接 to do / to(wards) n.
uncommonMeanings.example: She has a strong natural tendency towards art. 她天生酷爱艺术。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数 tendencies）（潜在的）倾向、苗头
uncommonMeanings.example: He showed suicidal tendencies. 他表现出自杀倾向。

posExamples.sentence: The data shows a tendency towards slower growth.

wordForms.verb: tend vi. 倾向于（tend to do sth）；照料（tend (to) sb/sth）

collocations.translation: 课文原句：借用外来词的倾向/风潮

collocations.phrase: an increasing tendency for sb to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】某人做某事这一趋势在增加
collocations.example: There is an increasing tendency for women to have children later in life. 女性晚育的趋势在增加。
She has a strong natural tendency to/towards art. 她天生就非常喜爱艺术。
Some people may inherit a tendency towards alcoholism. 有些人可能遗传酗酒的倾向。
She has displayed artistic tendencies. 她已显露出艺术天分。

Sofia was in the bedroom tending to her son. 索菲娅在卧室里照顾儿子。

collocations.phrase: have a tendency to do sth

translation: adv. 真诚地，诚实地
original_sentence: Jake: (Making eye contact and speaking slowly and sincerely) When I was trying out your skateboard, I slipped.
definitionEn: in an honest, genuine, and heartfelt way; also used to close a formal letter

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 真诚地，诚恳地（修饰 apologize/speak 等言语行为）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 由衷地（加强 hope/believe/regret 等心理动词）
uncommonMeanings.example: I sincerely believe this is the right choice. 我由衷地相信这是正确的选择。

posExamples.sentence: I sincerely apologize for the confusion.

wordForms.adverb: sincerely 真诚地；反义词 insincerely
wordForms.other: 构词：sincere + -ly；注意名词 sincerity 重音后移 /sɪnˈserəti/，而 sincere /sɪnˈsɪə(r)/、sincerely /sɪnˈsɪəli/ 重音都在第二音节

collocations.translation: 课文原句：语速缓慢、态度诚恳地说

There was a sincere expression of friendliness on both their faces. 两人脸上都流露出真诚的友好。
I was impressed with his deep sincerity. 他深深的诚意打动了我。
I sincerely hope you can forgive me. 我衷心希望你能原谅我。

translation: n. 比赛，竞赛；争夺，竞争 /kənˈtest/ vt. 争取赢得；争辩，就…提出异议
original_sentence: I think he’ll be very angry when he finds out—he has a contest this weekend!
definitionEn: (1) a competition (2) to challenge or dispute a claim, result, or position

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 比赛，竞赛（常有评委评判，如演讲、歌唱、美术类）
uncommonMeanings.example: She came first in the poetry contest. 她在诗歌比赛中获得第一名。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （权力、职位的）争夺，竞争
uncommonMeanings.example: The leadership contest attracted three candidates. 领导权之争吸引了三名候选人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 争夺，角逐；争取赢得（职位、席位、奖项等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Three candidates contested the leadership. 三名候选人角逐领导权。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对……提出异议，质疑（判决、遗嘱、说法等）
uncommonMeanings.example: His brothers are contesting the will. 他的兄弟们正对遗嘱提出异议。

posExamples.sentence: Our school won the regional science contest.
Two candidates contested the final seat.
The company intends to contest the fine.

wordForms.noun: contest /ˈkɒntest/ 比赛，竞争；contestant /kənˈtestənt/ 竞争者，选手（课件）
wordForms.verb: contest /kənˈtest/ 争夺；对……提出异议
wordForms.other: 重音贴士：名前动后——名词 /ˈkɒntest/ 重音在前，动词 /kənˈtest/ 重音在后，同类词有 record、present、protest、increase；contestant = contest + -ant（表人后缀，比较 assistant、participant）

collocations.example: I think he’ll be very angry when he finds out—he has a contest this weekend! 我想他发现后会非常生气——他这周末有一场比赛！
Our school will hold a speech contest. 我们学校将举办一场演讲比赛。
a contest for the leadership of the party 争夺政党领导权的竞争

collocations.translation: 【课件】争夺领导权（contest 作及物动词）
collocations.example: Three candidates contested the leadership. 三名候选人角逐领导权。
It was a fiercely contested game. 那是一场争夺激烈的比赛。
His brothers are contesting the will. 他的兄弟们正对遗嘱提出异议。

collocations.phrase: enter / take part in a contest
collocations.example: She entered a singing contest last year. 她去年参加了一场歌唱比赛。
He won the English speech contest. 他赢得了英语演讲比赛。

collocations.phrase: a contest between A and B
collocations.translation: A 与 B 之间的较量
collocations.example: The election was a contest between two parties. 这次选举是两党之间的较量。

synonyms.example: There is fierce competition for university places. 大学名额竞争激烈。
synonyms.usage: competition 最常用，既指具体比赛又指抽象的"竞争"（不可数）；contest 多指有评委评判的比赛（演讲、歌唱等）或权位之争，且可作及物动词（contest the leadership），competition 无动词用法（其动词是 compete，不及物，compete for/with）

synonyms.translation: 比赛（球类、棋类等对抗性比赛）
synonyms.example: We watched a football match yesterday. 我们昨天看了一场足球赛。
synonyms.usage: match 指两方对抗的体育比赛（football/tennis/chess match）；contest 侧重评比类比赛或激烈争夺，课文中的 a contest 泛指他这周末要参加的比赛

synonyms.translation: 赛跑；（速度上的）竞赛，角逐
synonyms.example: He came second in the 100-metre race. 他在百米赛跑中得了第二。
synonyms.usage: race 强调比速度（赛跑、赛车），引申指角逐（the race for president）；contest 不限于速度，泛指各类竞赛与争夺

advancedExpressions.expression: hold / enter / win / lose a contest；a contest for...（争夺……）；a contest between A and B（A 与 B 的较量）；a speech / singing / beauty contest
advancedExpressions.example: She won first prize in the speech contest held by our school. 她在我们学校举办的演讲比赛中获得一等奖。

advancedExpressions.expression: contest the leadership / an election / a seat（角逐领导权/选举/席位）；contest a will / a decision（对遗嘱/决定提出异议）；a fiercely contested game（激烈争夺的比赛，过去分词作定语）
advancedExpressions.example: The party decided not to contest the election. 该党决定不参加此次选举角逐。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·重音移位（名前动后）
advancedExpressions.expression: contest n. /ˈkɒntest/ — v. /kənˈtest/；同类：record、present、protest、increase、import；派生：contest + -ant → contestant 选手
advancedExpressions.example: Each contestant /kənˈtestənt/ has three minutes to speak. 每位选手有三分钟发言时间。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·比赛与竞争
advancedExpressions.expression: contest（评比类比赛/权位之争）/ competition（泛指比赛、竞争）/ match（对抗性球赛）/ race（速度赛、角逐）/ tournament（锦标赛、联赛）
advancedExpressions.example: He is preparing for a chess tournament. 他正在备战一场国际象棋锦标赛。

advancedExpressions.expression: contest 作先行词，指物，关系词用 which/that，介词提前时用 in which：the contest (that/which) he will take part in = the contest in which he will take part
advancedExpressions.example: The contest in which he will compete takes place this weekend. 他将参加的那场比赛于本周末举行。
